reason: Adds self-hosted web search and web page fetching to DeepSeek Harness through SearXNG and Crawl4AI provider integrations.

summaries.zh: 通过集成自托管的 SearXNG 和 Crawl4AI 服务，为 DeepSeek Harness 提供网页搜索与网页抓取能力。
summaries.en: Adds web search and page fetching to DeepSeek Harness by integrating self-hosted SearXNG and Crawl4AI services.

capabilities: Sends web search requests to configured SearXNG services
Fetches HTTP(S) pages through configured Crawl4AI services
Uses optional API keys from configuration or environment variables
Registers web_search and web_fetch providers with DeepSeek Harness
